source_differences.xml_or_narrative_literal: AAAAUS29 instructs ABABUS23, under Service Level CTRV - 356, to collect USD 1025 from account 123456, owned by Jones, the debtor, and serviced by BBBBUS39. The mandate related information is also provided: the mandate reference is VIRGAY123 and the mandate was signed by Jones on 13 July 2008. The last collection is due to take place on 13 July 2015. The payment is for life insurance. The requested collection date is 13 July 20102 and charges related to the handling of the instruction are shared between the creditor and the debtor.
